title: Key West UFO Tour
includes: Shared use of military-grade night vision monocular

Search for UFOs with your military-grade night vision scope as we blow your mind with tales of UFOs, UAPs, alien encounters, and the hidden history of UFOs in Key West. Small groups, local guides, little-known history, and oceanfront viewing sites make this a unique, unusual, unforgettable experience. Your $5000 night vision scope will change how you see the night sky forever. This experience is dependent on suitable viewing conditions. If we cancel you will have the option to reschedule or be refunded.
